title: Type into the terminal pane
description:
As the student, I want to interact with my running program in the IDE.

Feature: Terminal pane
  Scenario: Answer a prompt
    Given a running program that asks for a name
    When the student types Ada and presses Enter in the terminal pane
    Then the terminal pane shows Hello, Ada
right_now_summary: The terminal pane needs to accept input from students running programs.
